title: Amartha 10X Run 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Amartha 10X Run 2026 review: thousands of runners from GBK past Bundaran HI on 6 September, snack-stocked water stations and a village-themed finish.
dek: Fintech lender Amartha's race took thousands of runners from Gelora Bung Karno past Bundaran HI on 6 September 2026. Here is what it was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Amartha 10X Run is a Jakarta brand race that puts as much effort into the finish area as the course. The 2026 edition drew thousands of runners to Gelora Bung Karno for a 10 km and a half marathon past Bundaran HI [1]. The water stations stocked sponsors' snacks as well as water [1], and the finish was a village-themed race village where runners could take home betta fish, fruit and vegetables and meet the small businesses Amartha lends to [1]. If you want a fun, well-stocked city race in central Jakarta, it delivers. The reporting says little about the course itself.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: Thousands of runners took part in the Amartha 10X Run at Gelora Bung Karno, Jakarta, under the theme #WeGoBeyond [1]. There were two distances, 10 km and the half marathon, and the route took in Jakarta landmarks including the Bundaran HI roundabout [1].
Youth and Sports Minister Erick Thohir spoke at the event, and Amartha's founder Andi Taufan tied the race to the company's work with small businesses run by women in villages across Indonesia [1].

sections.heading: Water Stations and the Race Village
paragraphs: The water stations offered more than water. Runners were handed snacks from the event's sponsors, from nuggets and sweets to cheese, bagels, fried chicken and orange juice [1].

After the finish, a village-themed race village let runners rest, play games and take home betta fish, fruit and vegetables [1]. Small businesses that Amartha finances sold their products there, and runners could even fund them through the company's lending app [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you live in Jakarta and want a race that is as much a festival as a run, yes. A GBK start and a route past Bundaran HI is as central as Jakarta races get.
If you are chasing a time, it is less obviously your race. The reporting is about the experience, not results, timing or the course profile, so check those details before you enter.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What distances does the Amartha 10X Run offer?
faqs.answer: Two in 2026: a 10 km and a half marathon, both starting from Gelora Bung Karno (GBK) in central Jakarta. The route passed Jakarta landmarks including the Bundaran HI roundabout before returning to GBK.

faqs.question: What is different about the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: The finish area. In 2026 the water stations handed out sponsors' snacks as well as water, and the village-themed race village let runners take home betta fish, fruit and vegetables and buy from the small businesses that Amartha, a lender to village businesses, finances.

faqs.question: How big is the Amartha 10X Run?
faqs.answer: Thousands of runners took part in the 2026 edition at GBK. The report on the race does not give an exact figure. The event draws a Jakarta crowd, with the country's youth and sports minister attending in 2026.
